instances.text: You inspect possible directed transfers between distinct nodes. There are 4 vertices numbered zero through 3, and the complete list of directed edges is 0 to 3; 1 to 2; 2 to 0; 2 to 3; 3 to 1; 3 to 2. There are no other edges. Count ordered pairs of different vertices for which at least one directed path goes from the first vertex to the second. Count a pair only once even if several paths exist, and exclude all self-pairs. What is the count, as a whole number?
